cues.text: At Naganaki Shrine, a boy clings to the top of the jungle gym while a dog growls up at him. You, Koromaru and the girl run up.
Koromaru walks up to face the dog, and you follow behind him.
The dog backs away and runs off. The girl runs over to Koromaru.
The boy is down from the jungle gym now, standing with you, the girl and Koromaru.
